question: The area of the base of a right circular cone is 3136 π cm² and its slant height is 65 cm. The curved surface area of the cone (in cm²) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Base Area** = πr² = 3136π ⇒ r = √3136 = 56 cm.

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** = πrl.

Given **Slant Height (l)** = 65 cm.

CSA = π × 56 × 65 = 3640π cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 3640π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Base Area** of cone = 3136π cm²

**Slant Height (l)** = 65 cm

**Formula:**

Area of circular base = πr²

Curved Surface Area = πrl

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44140f056d596bbf670f0ec0b712ac02627a7dd5086eea62edbfa73812483fcd.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ πr² = 3136π

⇒ r² = 3136

⇒ r = √3136 = 56 cm

⇒ CSA = π × r × l

⇒ CSA = π × 56 × 65

⇒ CSA = 3640π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 3640π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cone

It is the sum of the curved surface area and the base area: TSA = πr(l + r).

Volume of a Cone

The capacity of a cone is given by: Volume = (1/3)πr²h, where h is the vertical height.

Relation between h, r, and l

By Pythagoras theorem in a right circular cone: l² = r² + h².</p
